blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multilingual dense retrievers place all languages in one shared space so that a question finds relevant documents, regardless of which language they are written in. We show that the same question, asked in different languages, retrieves substantially different documents, and this disagreement is not because of weak language understanding. Each language performs well on its own and ranks candidates consistently with the other languages; divergence appears only when languages share an index. We trace the mechanism: each language keeps its own ranking, but in the shared index, its correct answers are pushed far down, buried under non-relevant documents that are either in the query's own language or in English, depending on the model. We introduce disagreement-guided steering: for each language, we contrast the documents that other languages agree on for a question against those that language retrieves idiosyncratically, and take the difference of their representations as a language-specific direction, added to that language's queries at inference. Against baselines of language-mean removal, subspace removal, and per-language rotation, it most strongly reduces same-language crowding while remaining competitive on recall, trading off against mean removal, which better preserves ranking quality.
blocks.zh: 多语种稠密检索器将所有语言放在一个共享的空间中,这样一个问题就能找到相关的文档,不管它们用哪种语言写出. 我们显示,用不同语言问到的同一问题检索到的文档大相径庭,这种分歧并非因为语言理解薄弱. 每种语言本身都表现良好,候选人的排名与其他语言一致;只有在语言共用索引时才会出现分歧。 我们追踪这个机制:每种语言都保持自己的排名,但在共享索引中,它的正确答案被推得非常低,被埋入不相关的文档中,这些文档要么是查询自己的语言,要么是英语,取决于模型. 我们引入了分歧指导:对于每种语言,我们把其他语言就一个问题所商定的文件与那些从语言中回溯到通常情况的文件作对比,并将它们表述的不同作为语言特定方向,加上该语言推论中的疑问。 对照语言-正值删除、子空间删除和每个语言旋转的基线,它最能减少同一种语言的拥挤,同时在召回问题上保持竞争力,与平均删除进行交换,这更好地保持了排名质量。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multilingual dense retrievers map queries and documents from many languages into one vector space, so that relevance rather than language decides what is retrieved ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . The intent is met unevenly. The same model retrieves well for some query languages and fails badly for others, as documents in the query’s own language, or in English, fill the top ranks and push relevant foreign-language documents out ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Amiraz et al., 2025 ) . What separates the languages that fail from those that succeed is not visible in their scores.
blocks.zh: 多语言稠密检索器将来自多种语言的查询和文件映射到一个矢量空间,这样关联性而不是语言决定检索的内容(Wang等,2024;Zhang等,2025.). 意图的实现是不均衡的。 同一模式为某些查询语言检索良好,而为其他查询语言检索失败,因为查询语言中的文件或英文中的文件填补了最高排位并推出相关的外语文件(Yang等,2025;Wang等,2026;Amiraz等,2025)。 将失败的语言与成功语言区分开来,在他们的分数中是看不到的.

blocks.en:
Scoring a language against gold labels shows how often it retrieves the right documents, but not why it misses them. To see why, we ask the same question in several languages and compare what each retrieves.
The retrieved sets diverge, and how they diverge is diagnostic.
We call this cross-lingual disagreement and make it our object of study.
It requires no relevance labels and characterizes failed language by its departure from successful languages rather than by a single number.
blocks.zh:
校对:Soup 为了了解原因,我们用几种语言提出同样的问题,并比较每种语言的检索内容。
回收的套件有差异,它们如何是诊断性的。
我们把这种跨文化的分歧称为我们的研究目标。
它不需要相关的标签,也不需要通过脱离成功语言来描述失败语言,而不是通过一个数字来描述失败语言.

blocks.en: Disagreement is diagnostic because it separates two explanations that a single score cannot. A language may fail because the model represents it poorly, or because the languages interfere only once they share an index. The two call for different fixes, better training in the first case, a geometric correction in the second, but from gold scores alone, they look identical. Prior work does not separate them: monolingual and cross-lingual retrieval are typically measured on different collections, confounding the effect of mixing with a change of items, while audits quantify how unequal the mixed ranking is ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , and mitigations act on the output space, transforming the index ( Jang et al., 2026 ) , removing language identity post hoc ( Kim et al., 2026 ) , projecting out a language subspace ( Xie et al., 2022 ) , or correcting hubness ( Lample et al., 2018 ; Sakhawat et al., 2026 ) . Each presupposes which explanation holds rather than testing it.
blocks.zh: 分歧是诊断性的,因为它将单一分数不能的两个解释分开. 一种语言可能因为模型代表它不好而失败,或者因为语言只有在共享索引时才会干涉. 两者要求不同的修饰,第一种情况下更好的训练,第二种情况下的几何校正,但仅从金分数来看,它们看起来是一样的. 先前的工作并没有将它们分开:单语和跨语检索通常在不同集合上进行测量,混淆了混合与项目变化的影响,而审计则量化了混合排名的不平等程度(Wang等,2026年),并减轻了对输出空间的作用,转换了索引(Jang等,2026年),删除了语言身份后临时(Kim等,2026年),投射出一个语言子空间(Xie等,2022年),或纠正了中枢(Lample等,2018年;Sakhawat等,2026年). 每一种解释都预先假定哪一种解释存在,而不是检验它。

blocks.en:
Disagreement can be read at three points, each answering a different question.
Among languages retrieving only within their own documents, it asks whether they behave alike in isolation. They do: every language retrieves competently and orders concepts much as the others do, so representational quality is not the binding constraint.
Between monolingual and mixed retrieval, it asks what sharing an index changes. The answer is composition rather than order: each language keeps its internal ranking, while its documents drop far down the combined list, displaced by same-language non-relevant material rather than by globally popular hub documents ( Lample et al., 2018 ; Sakhawat et al., 2026 ) .
Among languages competing inside the mixed index, it asks whether they converge. They do not, and the divergence follows two regimes: some models crowd a query with its own language, while others pull the ranking toward English.
The pattern is directional: a language’s documents stay reachable by other languages’ queries, while its own queries retrieve almost exclusively within that same language ( Lim et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
分歧可在三分读取,每分答出不同的问题.
在只从自己的文件中检索的语文中,它问它们是否在孤立中的行为相同。 它们确实如此:每一种语言都像其他语言一样,能正确检索并命令概念,因此,代表性质量不是有约束力的限制。
在单一语言和混合检索之间,它询问共享指数的变化是什么。 答案是组成而非顺序:每种语言都保持内部排名,而其文件则会大大地降低综合列表,被同语言无关的材料所取代,而不是被全球流行的枢机文件所取代(Lample等,2018;Sakhawat等,2026.).
在混合索引内相互竞争的语言中,它询问它们是否趋同. 他们不这样做,分歧遵循两种制度:一些模型用自己的语言来吸引一个查询,而另一些则将排名推向英语。
其模式是方向性的:一种语言的文件仍可被其他语言的查询所取取,而其本身的查询则几乎完全取取自同一语言(Lim等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
Disagreement is also actionable. Knowing which documents other languages retrieve and which they miss gives not only the size of the gap but also a direction across it.
We introduce disagreement-guided steering: contrast the documents other languages agree on for a question against those a language retrieves idiosyncratically, and add the difference of their representations to that language’s queries at inference.
This requires no neuron attribution, no training, and no relevance labels; its directions are estimated on a separate corpus, never on the evaluation data. We compare it against per-language mean removal ( Libovický et al., 2020 ) , language-subspace removal ( Xie et al., 2022 ) , and rotation toward a cross-lingual consensus ( Liu et al., 2019 ) . The corrections are separated by what they repair: mean removal gives the best ranking quality and rank agreement, while steering gives the largest reduction in same-language crowding and remains competitive on recall, and holds up on non-parallel corpora, where documents are not translations of one another.
blocks.zh:
分歧也可以采取行动。 了解哪些文件可以检索到其他语言,以及它们错过的,不仅给出了差距的大小,而且还给出了跨越差距的方向。
我们引入了分歧指导:将其他语言所商定的问题文件与其他语言所商定的问题相对照,
这不需要神经元的归属,不需要训练,也不需要贴上相关的标签;其方向是在单独的体上估算的,从不在评价数据上. 我们把它与每个语言的平均去除(Libovický等,2020年),语言-子空间去除比较. (谢等,2022年),并进行轮回以达成跨语言共识(刘等,2019年). 校正按其修补内容来划分:即去除意味着获得最好的排位质量和排位协议,而取向则在同一种语言的挤占方面给予最大的减少,在召回方面仍然具有竞争力,在文件互不译出的非平行的股权上则搁置.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: (1) Cross-lingual disagreement as a label-free diagnostic, read within languages, across the monolingual-to-mixed transition, and among languages sharing an index. (2) An anatomy of cross-lingual retrieval failure: demotion rather than loss of correct answers, displacement by same-language non-relevant documents rather than hubs, two model-dependent crowding regimes, and a directional asymmetry between documents and queries. (3) Disagreement-guided steering, an inference-time correction derived from retrieval disagreement, requiring no training and no access to the evaluation corpus. 1 1 1 Code, scripts, and the estimation pools will be released publicly upon acceptance.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: (1)作为无标签诊断的跨语言分歧,在语言内读取,在单一语言到混合的过渡过程中,在共享索引的语言之间. (2)交叉语言检索失败的解剖学:降级而不是丢失正确答案,被同语言无关的文档而不是中枢所取代,两个模型依赖的集合制度,文档和查询之间的方向不对称. (3) 分歧指导,从检索分歧中得出的推论时间校正,不需要培训,也无需查阅评价资料。 1 1 1 守则、脚本和估计集合一旦接受,将公布。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
A long line of work characterizes multilingual embedding spaces through their geometry and corrects them accordingly. Lample et al. (2018) showed that a few hub vectors become nearest neighbors of almost everything in high-dimensional spaces and proposed CSLS as a correction, which later work extended with normalization steps that strip language-specific structure before alignment ( Ruder et al., 2019 ; Aboagye et al., 2022 ; Pan et al., 2025 ) . A second strand targets language identity directly: Roy et al. (2020) and Reimers and Gurevych (2020) showed that embeddings clustering by language causes retrievers to prefer irrelevant same-language documents over relevant foreign ones, Libovický et al. (2020) and Yang et al. (2021) removed this bias by subtracting per-language means, and Xie et al. (2022) showed that language identity occupies a low-rank subspace
that can be projected away. Orthogonal Procrustes alignment provides a third correction, long used to relate separately trained embedding spaces ( Liu et al., 2019 ; Lample et al., 2018 ) . We evaluate all three under identical conditions and against a correction that, rather than assuming a fixed geometric form, derives its direction from retrieval behavior.
blocks.zh:
多语种嵌入空间通过其几何学具有长期工作特征,并相应地加以纠正。 Lample等人(2018年)显示,少数枢机向量成为了高维空间中几乎所有事物的近邻并提出了将CSLS作为校正,后期工作随着常态化步骤而延伸,在对齐前剥去语言特定结构(Ruder等人,2019年;Aboagye等人,2022年;Pan等人,2025年). 第二行直接针对语言特性: Roy等 (2020年)和Reimers和Gurevich (2020年)显示,由语言进行嵌入会导致被检索者更喜欢不相干同文文件而不是相关的外文文件,Libovický等 (2020年)和Yang等 (2021年)通过去除每个语言手段来去除这种偏差,而Xie等. (2022)显示语言身份占据了低等子空间.
这可以被抛出。 Orthogonal Procrustes 校正提供了第三个校正,长期用于连接单独训练的嵌入空间(Liu等,2019;Lample等,2018.). 我们评价这三者在相同条件下,对照一种修正,而不是假定一种固定的几何形式,它的方向来自检索行为。

blocks.en:
Language bias in retrieval has been documented and mitigated at the level of the final ranking. Yang et al. (2025) showed that multilingual retrievers treat query languages unequally and proposed a training objective to reduce the gap. Wang et al. (2026) found that multilingual RAG pipelines systematically promote English and query-language documents. Mitigations transform the document index ( Jang et al., 2026 ) or edit language identity out of the output embeddings ( Kim et al., 2026 ) .
All of these measure a language against gold labels: they establish that some languages retrieve worse than others, but not why, since a per-language score never compares one language’s retrievals against another’s.
We measure languages against one another instead, which requires no relevance judgments and distinguishes retrieving different material from retrieving the same material in a worse position.
blocks.zh:
在最后排名一级,已记录并减轻了检索中的语言偏差。 杨等. (2025年)显示多语种检索器对查询语言的处理不平等,并提出了一个减少差距的培训目标. Wang等 (2026)发现多语种RAG管道系统推广英语和查询语言文件. 缓解会将文档索引(Jang等,2026年)或编辑语言身份从输出嵌入(Kim等,2026年)中转换出.
所有这些都用金色的标签来衡量一种语言:它们确定有些语言的检索比其他语言更差,但并不是为什么,因为每个语言的得分从不比较一种语言的检索。
相反,我们相互衡量语言,这不需要相关判断,并区分检索不同材料和检索处于更不利地位的相同材料。

blocks.en: Modifying model weights at inference has become a standard alternative to fine-tuning, both for controlling generation ( Turner et al., 2024 ; Rimsky et al., 2024 ) and for improving multilingual behavior. Sundar et al. (2025) identifies expert neurons and modulates them to increase cross-lingual alignment in multilingual language models, reporting gains on cross-lingual retrieval, while Guo et al. (2024) steers activations in a generative reader within a CLIR pipeline, and Pokharel et al. (2026) selectively modulates neuron activations for multilingual classification and generation. These approaches locate the intervention through attribution, by identifying which units encode a property, and require an anchor language or a target behavior to steer toward. Our construction differs in the source of the direction: we obtain it from the retrieval behavior of the languages themselves.
blocks.zh: 在推论中修改模型权重已经成为微调的标准替代品,既用于控制生成(Turner等,2024;Rimsky等,2024)也用于改善多语种行为. Sundar等 (2025年) 鉴定出专家神经元并对其进行调制,以在多语言语言模型中增加跨语言相接性,报告跨语言检索上的进展;而Guo等. (2024)在CLIR管内的基因读取器中引导活化,而Pokharel等(2026)选择性地调制神经元活化,用于多语种分类和生成. 这些方法通过归属来定位干预,通过确定哪个单位编码一个地产,并需要一种锚地语言或目标行为来向着. 我们的构造在方向的来源上有所不同: 我们从语言本身的检索行为中获得它.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Multilingual retrievers are trained so that a query in any language reaches the relevant documents in every other language. Whether they do is normally judged one language at a time, by scoring each ranking against relevance labels. Such a score establishes that some languages are served worse than others, but it does not reveal the character of the loss: a language may retrieve unrelated material, or the right material only in its own language, or the right material demoted beneath documents no other language would have chosen. These are distinct failures with distinct remedies, and a single number cannot separate them.
blocks.zh: 多语种检索器得到培训,以便以任何语言查询以其他语言送达有关文件。 他们是否这样做通常一次被评为一种语言,通过对照相关标签对每个排名进行评分. 这样的分数确定,有些语言的服务比其他语言更差,但并不显示损失的特征:一种语言可能只取回不相干的材料,或者正确的材料只取回自己的语言,或者正确的材料被降级到其他语言不会选择的文件下. 这些都是有不同补救办法的明显失败,一个数字不能将它们分开。

blocks.en: We therefore evaluate the rankings against each other rather than against labels alone. On parallel collections, one information need exists in every language, and each passage exists as translations that we treat as one item, so the rankings produced by different languages become directly comparable. Their pairwise relation, which we call cross-lingual agreement, is measured at three points that isolate successive stages of retrieval: within languages restricted to their own documents, where competition is absent; between a language’s restricted and shared-index rankings, where the only change is the presence of other languages; and among languages inside the shared index, where they compete directly.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们相互评价排名,而不是仅仅评价标签。 在平行的集合中,每种语言都存在一个信息需要,每个段落都作为我们作为一个项目处理的翻译存在,因此由不同语言制作的排名变得直接可比较. 他们的对等关系,我们称之为跨语言协议,是用三个点来衡量的,它们隔离了连续的检索阶段:在仅限于自己文件的语言内部,在没有竞争的情况下;在一个语言的受限排名和共享索引排名之间,其中唯一的变化是其他语言的存在;在共享索引内部的语言之间,它们直接竞争。

blocks.en: Disagreement also shows how to fix a failing language. For a question, the other languages find documents that this language misses, and it retrieves documents they avoid. Subtracting the average of the second group from the average of the first, in embedding space, gives a direction that points from where this language’s queries land toward where the others’ do. We average this over questions to get one direction per language, weighting questions by how much the language disagrees on them, and add it to its queries at retrieval time. We steer queries only, leaving document embeddings untouched. This keeps the method inference-only and requires no re-encoding or re-indexing of the collection: the correction is applied per query at search time, so it can be dropped into an existing index without rebuilding it.
blocks.zh: 分歧还表明如何修复一个失败的语言. 对于一个问题,其他语言会找到这种语言缺失的文档,它会检索它们所避免的文件. 在嵌入空间中,将第二组的平均值从第一组的平均值中减去,给出了一个方向,从该语言的查询到其他语言的查询。 我们把这个问题放在每个语言一个方向上, 以语言的分歧程度来权衡问题, 在检索时把它加进它的查询中。 我们只引导查询,使嵌入文件不受影响。 这只保留了方法推论,不需要重新编码或重新索引集合:在搜索时每个查询都会应用校正,因此可以不重建就将其降入已存在的索引.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate three multilingual retrieval collections with complementary structures. Belebele ( Bandarkar et al., 2024 ) and XQuAD ( Artetxe et al., 2019 ) are fully parallel: every passage exists in all languages and shares a semantic identity, so retrieved sets are directly
comparable across languages and disagreement can be measured directly. Belebele spans ten languages across five scripts, XQuAD six. Multi-EuP ( Yang et al., 2023 ) is included for contrast: drawn from real European Parliament speeches, its language pools are strongly imbalanced, and its relevance comes from human-assigned subject labels rather than translation identity, so documents do not correspond one-to-one across languages. It tests whether findings from clean parallel conditions survive in a realistic index. All documents are passage-level, so single-vector retrieval is not confounded with long-document aggregation. Appendix A gives languages, access, and licensing.
blocks.zh:
我们评价三个具有补充结构的多语种检索集。 Belebele(Bandarkar等,2024年)和 uAD(Artetxe等,2019年)是完全平行的:每个段落都以所有语言存在并共享语义特征,所以被检索的集是直接的.
可以直接衡量各语文之间的可比性和分歧。 Belebele跨出十种语言,跨越了五个脚本,"QQuAD 6". 多个EuP (Yang等,2023年)被列作对比:取自欧洲议会真实的演讲,其语言集合严重失衡,其相关性出自人所指定的主题标签而不是翻译身份,因此文档不对应一对一的跨语言. 它检验从清洁的平行条件中得出的结论是否以现实的指数存在。 所有文档都是通过级的,因此单向源检索不会与长文件汇总相混淆. 附 录 A给予语言、访问和许可证。

blocks.en: We evaluate seven multilingual embedding models. mE5-base and mE5-large ( Wang et al., 2024 ) are encoder-based retrievers used with their official query: and passage: prefixes and mean pooling. BGE-M3 ( Chen et al., 2024 ) is a further encoder-based retriever, evaluated in its single-vector dense mode with CLS pooling and no prompt, as its training prescribes. Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and Qwen3-Embedding-8B ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) are decoder-based, read out at the final token, and included as a matched pair so that scale can be varied within one family. e5-mistral (e5-mistral-7b-instruct) is a decoder-based instruction embedding model ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2022 ) . It uses last-token pooling and is less cleanly multilingual because its backbone is English-centric. EmbeddingGemma-300M ( Vera et al., 2025 ) is a compact decoder-based model with mean pooling and task-prefixed inputs, whose two projection heads we apply so that its final representation matches the deployed embedding. Every model is used in inference mode without training, and each is evaluated only in the pooling and prompt configuration its documentation specifies. The details regarding the model and experimental procedures can be found in Appendix B .

blocks.en:
All interventions require language-level statistics.
Estimating these on the evaluation index would make the corrections transductive, so we estimate them on a separate corpus.
We use FLORES-200 ( Team et al., 2022 ) for XQuAD and Multi-EuP, as they have no shared content with it. Belebele, however, is built from FLORES passages; so we estimate Belebele’s directions on TED2020 ( Qi et al., 2018 ) , which shares no content with Belebele. The steering scale α \alpha is selected on the estimation corpus and held fixed across datasets; only the per-model value varies.

所有干预措施都需要语言一级的统计数据。
在评价指数上估计这些内容将使校正转录化,因此,我们用一个单独的书目来估计。
我们使用FLORES-200(Team等,2022年)用于QQuAD和多EuP,因为他们与它没有共享内容. 然而,Belebele是用FLORES通道建造的;因此我们估计Belebele在TED2020(Qi等,2018年)上的方向,这与Belebele没有共同内容. 指导尺度α-α在估计元件上选定,并固定在数据集之间;只有每个模型值不同。

blocks.en: We measure retrieval quality with Recall@20 and nDCG@20 at the final layer, in two variants that differ only in which gold copies count. All-gold nDCG/Recall count every copy of the answer, including the same-language one; we use these in the diagnosis to characterize the general effect of mixing. Cross-lingual nDCG/Recall count only foreign-language copies, excluding the same-language answer from both the hits and the ideal ranking; we use these for the interventions, to isolate the cross-lingual failure the corrections target. We also report the share of a query’s top-20 in its own language and in English, which separates self-crowding from English-gravity, and cross-lingual disagreement, the overlap and rank correlation between the rankings two languages produce for the same question, averaged over all other languages. Together, these capture whether a correction retrieves more relevant documents, changes which languages fill the ranking, and brings languages into agreement.
blocks.zh: 我们在最后一层用Recall@20和nDCG@20测量检索质量,用两个不同的变体来测量,这两个变体只计算黄金副本。 全金nDCG/召回计数每一份答案,包括同一种语言;我们在诊断时使用这些来描述混合的一般效果. 跨语言 nDCG/ recall只计外语版本,从点击量和理想排名中排除同语的答案;我们用这些作为干预,将跨语言的失败隔离出校正目标. 我们还报告一个查询的前20名在自己的语言和英语中所占的份额,这把自我拥挤与英语重力区分开来,以及跨语言的分歧,两种语言在排名上的重叠和排名关联性为同一问题所产生,平均分布于所有其他语言. 这些内容合在一起,可以捕捉更正是否检索到更相关的文档,更改哪些语言可以填补排名,并使语言达成一致.

Mixing demotes rather than disorders. Placing all languages in one index changes retrieval sharply, but not by scrambling them. Comparing each language’s monolingual ranking with its ranking in the shared index (Table 2 ), the internal order is largely preserved, between 56 56 and 76 76 on the parallel collections, while the correct foreign-language documents fall far down the list: their rank drops from the top to between 50 50 and 240 240 depending on the model; these documents reappear at larger retrieval cutoffs, confirming they are demoted rather than lost (Appendix E ).
The relevant documents are still ordered coherently relative to one another; they are simply buried beneath other material.

blocks.en: Cross-lingual retrieval works before competition. Table 1 shows each language retrieves well within its own documents, but not that it retrieves foreign -language documents well in isolation. We therefore test each query language against one foreign document-language pool at a time, before mixing all languages together. Retrieval is near-perfect in this bilingual setting: Recall@20 averages 97.8 97.8 (mE5-large), 92.8 92.8 (Qwen3-0.6B), and 97.6 97.6 (Qwen3-8B) across every language pair. The same queries and documents fail only once all languages compete in the shared index (Table 2 ). A representational deficit would show up in the bilingual pools too; it does not, so the failure is interference under competition, not an inability to represent foreign documents.

blocks.en: 5.2 What Replaces the Lost Documents

blocks.en:
We showed that mixing demotes correct foreign-language documents rather than disordering them. We now ask what takes their place.
For every query whose cross-lingual gold document leaves the top K K once the index is mixed, we classify each newly entering non-relevant document by its language relative to the query: the query’s own language, English, or another language. We also record how often an entrant is a hub; a document is a hub if its retrieval frequency, the number of queries whose top- K K list it enters, exceeds the 99th percentile of that distribution. Table 3 reports the composition of the two parallel collections.
blocks.zh:
我们显示,混合降级可以纠正外语文件,而不是扰乱它们。 我们现在问他们的位置是什么。
对于每一次交叉语言金文档在索引被混合后会留下上K K 的查询,我们都会根据查询的语言对新输入的无关文档进行分类:查询自己的语言、英语或其他语言。 我们还记录一个entrant是一个中枢的频率;如果一个文件的检索频率,即它输入的KK榜首的查询次数,超过该发行量的第99个百分位数,则它是一个中枢. 表3汇报了两个平行集合的构成情况。

blocks.en: Two regimes, separated by the language of the intruders. The models fall into two groups. In the first, on Belebele, entrants are almost entirely in the query’s own language: 88 88 – 92 % 92\% same-language for mE5-base, mE5-large, and e5-mistral, with English essentially absent (at most 0.5 % 0.5\% ). These models bury a query under its own language. In the second group, the same-language material is a minority, and the displaced slots are filled from other languages. For BGE-M3, Qwen, and Gemma, the same-language share falls to 9 9 – 38 % 38\% while other-language documents dominate. XQuAD shows the same two regimes. The two regimes seen in the aggregate rankings thus correspond to two distinct sources of interference at the level of individual documents.

English is the dominant intruder in the second regime. Within the second regime, English enters far more often than any single other language, rising from near zero in the self-crowding models to 7 7 – 19 % 19\% of entrants on Belebele. The other-language column appears larger, but it aggregates every remaining language, eight on Belebele and four on XQuAD, whereas English is a single language. blocks.en: The diagnosis shows that a language’s queries are misplaced in the shared space, not that the model fails to represent it. We therefore test corrections that act only on the final representation, comparing the disagreement-guided steering against mean removal , subspace removal , and rotation toward a cross-lingual consensus . All directions and hyperparameters are estimated on FLORES-200 (XQuAD, Multi-EuP) and TED2020 (Belebele).Table 4 reports recall, nDCG, and the own-language and English shares of the ranking.
blocks.zh: 诊断表明,一种语言的查询在共享空间中是错的,而不是模型未能代表它。 因此,我们测试那些只在最后代表问题上起作用的更正,比较分歧指导与平均删除、次空间去除和轮换,以达成跨语言的共识。 在FLORES-200(XQuAD,Multi-EuP)和TED2020(Belebele)上估算出所有方向和超参数. 表4报告回顾,nDCG,以及排名的自有语言和英语份额。

blocks.en: We include two controls: random , which removes the same number of directions as subspace removal but does so at random, and permuted , which subtracts the mean of a mismatched language. All directions are estimated over five independent estimation corpora samples, and we report the mean and standard deviation across these samples, which measure how much each correction depends on the particular estimation sample rather than on language identity.
blocks.zh: 我们包括两个控件:随机(随机),即去除与子空间去除相同的方向数,但随机进行,并被穿透(permuted),再去除不匹配语言的平均值. 所有方向都估计在5个独立估计的Corpora样本上,我们报告这些样本之间的平均和标准的偏差,它衡量每个校正在多大程度上取决于特定估计样本而不是语言特征.

blocks.en: Every correction recovers recall, but not in the same way. Mean removal, subspace removal, and steering raise cross-lingual recall over the untouched baseline, and differ in what else moves. Mean removal and steering recover recall while cutting the own-language share that drives the crowding: on mE5-large/Belebele steering lowers it from 69 % 69\% to 23 % 23\% and mean removal to 44 % 44\% . Where rotation does help, it does so by pulling rankings toward English, so its English share climbs, most visibly on mE5-large/Multi-EuP, where it rises from 35 % 35\% to 70 % 70\% , reproducing the bias the correction is meant to remove. Subspace removal is the mildest, moving every quantity only slightly. We report paired significance tests in Appendix G . We note that our design choices are not load-bearing: the rank-fusion constant and the weight w ℓ ​ ( x ) w_{\ell}(x) do not affect the results (Appendix F ).

Removing an equal number of random directions, in place of the language subspace, leaves retrieval within noise of the baseline, so the effect of subspace removal is not merely a consequence of discarding dimensions. Subtracting a mismatched language’s mean, drawn by permuting the language-to-mean assignment, sharply worsens retrieval and drives the own-language share toward saturation, so it is the correct per-language mean that matters, not the act of centering itself. The corrections that work therefore do so because they target language identity specifically. Appendix D traces two individual queries through each correction, illustrating how steering de-crowds the ranking while preserving the same-language answer.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We studied multilingual dense retrieval through cross-lingual disagreement: how the rankings different languages produce for the same need diverge in isolation and under competition in a shared index. This view separates failures that look identical under relevance metrics. A language may retrieve well alone, preserve its internal ranking under mixing, and still fail in the shared index because its relevant foreign-language documents are demoted beneath the same-language or English material. The failure is thus one of interference, not absent representation: correct cross-lingual documents are pushed down rather than lost, replaced mostly by non-relevant material whose language follows model-dependent regimes.
blocks.zh: 我们通过跨语言的分歧研究了多语种密集检索:不同语言的排名如何因同一需要而异,在共同指数的竞争中也存在差异。 这种观点将相关衡量标准下看起来相同的故障区分开来。 一种语言可能单独检索,在混合下保留其内部排名,在共享索引中仍然失败,因为其相关的外语文件被降级到同一种语言或英语材料下. 因此,失败是干扰,而不是缺乏代表性:正确的跨语言文件被推倒而不是丢失,取而代之的大多是语言遵循依赖模型的制度的非相关材料。

blocks.en: The same signal also corrects. Among training-free interventions estimated from an external corpus, mean removal, subspace removal, rotation, and disagreement-guided steering repair different aspects of the failure: mean removal gives stronger ranking quality, while steering improves recall and reduces own-language crowding. Relevance, agreement, and language composition move separately, so multilingual retrieval should be judged not only by how many relevant documents are found but by how languages disagree about what to retrieve. Cross-lingual disagreement offers both a label-free diagnostic of this interference and a practical signal for inference-time correction.
blocks.zh: 同样的信号也是正确的。 在外部文书估计的无培训干预中,平均清除、次空间清除、旋转和分歧指导性方向修复等不同方面的失败:平均清除提高了排名质量,而指导则改善了召回和减少自己语言的拥挤。 相关性、协议和语言组成是分开移动的,因此,不仅应当通过找到多少相关文件来判断多语种检索,而且应当通过语言如何对检索的内容产生分歧来判断。 跨语言分歧既为这种干扰提供了无标签的诊断,也为推论时间修正提供了实用信号.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our analysis treats retrieval disagreement as a diagnostic signal, not as an objective that should always be minimized. Different languages may legitimately retrieve different documents when corpora are not fully parallel, when relevance judgments are incomplete, or when the translated queries emphasize different aspects of the same information need. This is especially important for Multi-EuP, whose documents are not translation-equivalent and whose relevance judgments are graded rather than one-to-one. We therefore interpret disagreement on Multi-EuP as evidence of behavior under realistic multilingual competition, not as a direct semantic mismatch in the same sense as on Belebele and XQuAD.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析将检索分歧视为一个诊断信号,而不是一个应当永远尽量减少的目标。 不同的语言可以合法地取回不同的文件,如果corpora不完全平行,当相关判断不完整,或者当被翻译的询问强调同一信息需求的不同方面时. 这对多审制尤其重要,因为多审制的文件不等同于翻译,其相关判断是分级的而不是一对一的. 因此,我们把对多EuP的分歧解释为现实多语种竞争下行为的证据,而不是像Belebele和QQuAD一样意义上的直接语义错配.

blocks.en: The interventions require language identifiers and an external multilingual estimation corpus. We use FLORES to avoid fitting directions on the evaluation index, but this assumes that the language offsets and disagreement directions estimated from FLORES transfer to the target domain. Domain mismatch, noisy language identification, code-switching, and languages absent from the estimation corpus may reduce reliability. The steering method is training-free, but it still requires estimating one direction per language and choosing a scale; these choices may not be optimal for all models, domains, or retrieval depths.
blocks.zh: 干预措施需要语言识别资料和外部多语种估算资料。 我们使用FLORES来避免在评价指数上找到合适的方向,但这假设语言抵消了FLORES向目标域转移时估计到的分歧方向. 域名不匹配、语言识别吵闹、代码切换以及估计中缺少的语言可能会降低可靠性。 指导方法是无训练的,但它仍然需要估计每种语言的一个方向并选择一个尺度;这些选择可能不是所有模型、域或检索深度的最佳选择。

blocks.en: We evaluate single-vector dense retrieval at the final embedding layer. We do not study sparse-dense hybrid retrieval, rerankers, late-interaction models, or full retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, where later components may compensate for or amplify the disagreements observed here. We also focus on top-20 retrieval, which is appropriate for common retrieval and RAG settings but does not fully characterize deeper ranking behavior.
blocks.zh: 我们在最后嵌入层 评估单向量密集检索 我们不研究稀疏的混合检索、重新排序器、后期互动模型,或完全的检索加固生成管道,在那里,后期组件可以补偿或扩大这里观察到的分歧。 我们还注重于上20回取,这适合常见的回取和RAG设置,但并不充分描述更深层次的排名行为.

blocks.en: Finally, our interventions are diagnostic rather than definitive fixes. Mean removal, subspace removal, rotation, and disagreement-guided steering reveal different aspects of the geometry, but none removes multilingual retrieval bias uniformly. In particular, improving recall, improving nDCG, reducing own-language crowding, and increasing cross-language agreement are not the same objective. This trade-off is part of our finding, but it also limits how directly any single correction can be deployed as a universal solution.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们的干预是诊断性的,而不是确定性的。 平分去除,子空间去除,旋转,和有分歧的指向揭示出几何学的不同方面,但无一统一去除多语种检索偏差. 特别是,改进召回、改进nDCG、减少自发语言拥挤和增加跨语言协议不是同一目标。 这种取舍是我们调查结果的一部分,但也限制了任何单一更正如何能够作为普遍解决办法直接部署。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work mitigates a fairness-relevant failure, the unequal treatment of query languages in multilingual retrieval, and its gains fall most on the lowest-served languages. Two caveats: our steering correction can raise the English share of results on non-parallel data, which a language-sensitive deployment should weigh; and it assumes the query language is known, so noisy language identification could redistribute rather than remove bias. All datasets are public and contain no sensitive information. The environmental cost is low: the method trains nothing and runs in minutes on cached embeddings.
blocks.zh: 这项工作减轻了与公平有关的失败,减轻了在多语种检索中对查询语言的不平等待遇,其收益主要落在服务最少的语言上. 有两个警告:我们的方向校正可以提高非平行数据上的结果的英语比例,一个语言敏感部署应该加以权衡;它假定查询语言是已知的,因此吵吵的语言识别可以重新分配而不是去除偏差. 所有数据集都是公开的,不含敏感信息. 环境成本低:该方法在缓存嵌入物上不进行任何训练并用几分钟运行.

We use ten languages spanning high- and mid-resource levels and five scripts: English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Chinese, and Japanese. It is released under CC-BY-SA-4.0, which permits research use with attribution.
blocks.zh: Belebele(Bandarkar等,2024年)是一个平行的阅读理解基准,每个语言有900个问题. 我们使用10种跨越高和中资源水平的语言和5个脚本:英文、西班牙文、法文、意大利文、葡萄牙文、俄文、阿拉伯文、印地文、中文和日文。 它在CC-BY-SA 4.0下发布,允许有归属的研究使用.

blocks.en:
XQuAD ( Artetxe et al., 2019 ) is a parallel question answering benchmark of 240 passages and 1,190 question–answer pairs per language, translated from SQuAD v1.1. We use six languages, again spanning high- and mid-resource levels: English,
Spanish, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, and Chinese. It is released under CC-BY-SA-4.0, permitting research use with attribution.
blocks.zh:
QQuAD(Artetxe等,2019年)是一个平行的问答基准,由240个段落和1,190个问答对每个语言组成,由SQuAD v1.1翻译而来. 我们使用六种语言,这又跨越高和中资源水平: 英语,
西班牙语、俄语、阿拉伯语、印地语和中文。 它在CC-BY-SA-4.0下发布,允许有归属的研究用途.

blocks.en:
Multi-EuP ( Yang et al., 2023 ) is a non-parallel collection from European Parliament debates covering all 24 official EU languages, which range from high-resource (English, German, French) to lower-resource official languages (Maltese, Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian).
Its imbalanced pools and binary relevance make it our realistic stress test. Derived from public parliamentary proceedings, it is released for non-commercial research, under which our use falls.
blocks.zh:
多个EuP (Yang等,2023年)是欧洲议会辩论的非平行集,涵盖欧盟所有24种官方语言,从高资源(英语,德语,法语)到低资源官方语言(马耳他语,爱沙尼亚语,拉脱维亚语,立陶宛语)不等.
它不平衡的集合 和二进制的相关性 成为我们现实的压力测试。 从公开的议会程序推导出来,它被放出来进行非商业研究,根据这种研究,我们的用途已不复存在。

blocks.en:
FLORES-200 ( Team et al., 2022 ) is a parallel corpus covering 200 languages. We use it to estimate the language
statistics for XQuAD and Multi-EuP, taking 500 sentences per language from the development split for the languages present in each set. It is released under ODC-By, which permits research use with attribution.
blocks.zh:
FLORES-200(Team等,2022年)是一个涵盖200种语言的并行体. 我们用它来估计语言
统计 QQuAD 和 Multi-EuP 从每集语言的开发拆分中取出500个句子。 它在ODC-By下发布,允许研究与归属使用.

blocks.en: TED2020 ( Qi et al., 2018 ) is a corpus of TED and TED-X talk subtitles, crowd-translated into over 100 languages and sentence-aligned across them; this broad, many-way parallel coverage is what lets it serve as an estimation corpus. It is distributed under the TED Talks Usage Policy, under which the talks are licensed CC BY–NC–ND 4.0, permitting the non-commercial research use.
blocks.zh: TED2020(Qi等,2018年)是TED和TED-X谈话字幕的集合体,被翻译为超过100种语言,并贯穿于其中的句子;这种广泛,多向平行的覆盖使得它成为了一种估算要素. 它在TED会谈使用政策下分发,根据这项政策,谈判获得许可,允许非商业研究使用。

blocks.en:
Belebele comprises 9,000 queries over a 4,880-document index (10 languages), XQuAD 7,140 queries over 1,440 documents (6 languages),
and Multi-EuP 22,504 queries over 25,883 documents (24 languages). For the parallel collections, each query has a single cross-lingual gold per language; on Multi-EuP, the number of relevant documents varies (median: 23, range: 1–188). To our knowledge, none of the datasets contain private or sensitive personal information, and our method requires no additional data collection.

blocks.en: Appendix B Model and Experimental Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 模型和实验细节

blocks.en: Models. We evaluate seven publicly available embedding models, all accessed through their Hugging Face repositories and run in inference only, without fine-tuning. Table 5 summarizes their provenance, size, architecture, multilingual status, and license. All are explicitly multilingual and intended for multilingual retrieval, with the exception of e5-mistral, which is trained primarily on English data but is widely used for multilingual retrieval and included here to test whether our findings extend to a decoder not optimized for cross-lingual use.
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 我们评价了七个公开的嵌入模型,所有模型都通过它们的Hugging Face寄存器访问,并且只运行推论,没有微调. 表5概述了它们的出处、规模、建筑、多语种地位和许可证。 除e5-mistral外,所有数据都明确为多语种,意在进行多语种检索。 e5-mistral主要接受英语数据培训,但广泛用于多语种检索,并列入此处,以测试我们的调查结果是否扩大到不优化于跨语言使用的解码器。

blocks.en: We read out each model in the pooling and prompt configuration, its documentation specifies: mean pooling with the official query: / passage: prefixes for the mE5 models, CLS pooling for bge-m3, last-token pooling for the Qwen and e5-mistral decoders, and mean pooling with the projection heads applied for embedding-gemma. All licenses permit research use. For the layer-wise analysis, we extract a representation at every layer by applying each model’s deployed pooling to that layer’s hidden states and run retrieval on the pooled vectors. The pooling is identical across layers, so differences between layers reflect the representations, not the readout.
blocks.zh: 我们在集合和即时配置中阅读了每个模型,其文档中指定: 表示与正式查询的集合: / 段落: mE5模型的前缀, CLS 集合为 bge-m3, 表示为 Quen 和 e5- mistral 解码器的后缀集合, 表示为嵌入-gemma 应用的投影头集合. 所有许可证都允许研究使用。 从层次分析来看,我们通过将每个模型部署的集合应用到该层的隐藏状态并运行集合向量的检索来提取每一层的表示。 各层的集合是相同的,因此各层之间的差别反映了表示,而不是读出.

blocks.en: Hyperparameters. All retrieval uses cosine similarity over the final-layer embedding with a cutoff of K = 20 K=20 . All correction hyperparameters are selected on the estimation corpora, and each is set to the value that performs best there: the steering scale α \alpha , the subspace rank r r for subspace removal, and the shrinkage weight for mean removal. The subspace rank peaks at r = 10 r=10 for both a representative encoder and decoder, so no setting advantages our method over the baselines. The steering scale α \alpha is tuned per model rather than shared across models, since the architectures tolerate different amounts of steering. Disagreement-guided steering ( α \alpha ) is in the range 0.1 0.1 – 0.3 0.3 , norm-scaled by each query’s magnitude, with the consensus for each language formed by reciprocal-rank fusion (rank constant 60) over the other languages.
blocks.zh: 超参数 所有回取都使用同位素相近于末层嵌入,截取为K=20K=20. 所有校正超参数均被选取在估计的corpora上,每个参数设定为在那里表现最佳的值:方向尺 α\ alpha,亚空间去除的子空间分级 r,平均去除的收缩重. 代表编码器和解码器的子空间分级峰值为 r = 10 r = 10,因此没有设定我们的方法相对于基线的优势. 指导尺度α-α按模型调整,而不是在模型之间共享,因为结构可以容忍不同数量的引导. 歧见导向(α\alpha)在0.1 – 0.3 0.3 之间,规范按每个查询的大小进行分级,对每种语言的共识由对等分级聚变(常数为60)形成于其他语言.

blocks.en: Compute and training. Our method trains nothing. Every correction, including disagreement-guided steering, is estimated in closed form from precomputed embeddings: it introduces no learnable parameters, runs no gradient updates, and adds only a per-language vector or matrix applied to queries at inference. The only forward passes through the models are to extract embeddings for documents, queries, and the FLORES estimation corpus, done once per model and cached. All experiments run on a single GPU (NVIDIA A100 40GB); embedding extraction takes minutes to a few hours per model, depending on size, dominated by the 8B decoders, and every intervention on the cached embeddings, including the full alpha sweep and the multi-seed runs, completes in minutes. The per-language steering directions are the same dimension as the embedding (up to 4096) and add negligible cost at retrieval time.
blocks.zh: 计算与训练. 我们的方法什么也没有 每个修正,包括有分歧的向导,都是从预计算嵌入物中以封闭形式估算出来的:它引入了没有可学习的参数,运行了梯度更新,并且只添加了用于推论中查询的每个语言矢量或矩阵. 唯一通过模型的前进是提取嵌入文件、查询和FLORES估计元件,每个模型完成一次并被缓存。 所有实验在单个GPU(NVIDIA A100 40GB)上运行;嵌入取出每个模型需要几分钟到几小时的时间,视大小而定,由8B解码器主导,而缓存嵌入器上的每一个干预,包括完整的α扫描和多种子跑出,在几分钟后完成. 每种语言的指导方向与嵌入式(可达4096个)相同,在检索时间会增加可忽略不计的成本.

blocks.en: We test steering against mean removal with paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests over all model × \times dataset × \times language cells ( n = 184 n=184 ), per metric. The results confirm that steering’s advantage is de-crowding rather than a uniform win on retrieval quality (Table 10 ). The reduction in own-language share is large and highly significant ( Δ = − 9.7 \Delta=-9.7 , p < 10 − 19 p<10^{-19} ) and holds on all three collections individually. The recall difference favors steering on average ( + 2.7 +2.7 ) but is not significant ( p = 0.28 p=0.28 ), reflecting high per-language variance. nDCG is significant in opposite directions by collection: mean removal is higher on Belebele ( p = 0.004 p=0.004 ) and steering on XQuAD ( p = 0.007 p=0.007 ). blocks.en: The main results report intervention effects averaged over query languages, which can hide which languages a correction actually helps. Figure 1 breaks the effect down by language, comparing baseline, mean removal, and disagreement-guided steering on Recall@20 for an encoder (mE5-large) and a decoder (Qwen3-8B), on the parallel Belebele collection and a subset of the non-parallel Multi-EuP.
blocks.zh: 主要结果报告干预效果平均于查询语言,查询语言可以隐藏哪些修正实际帮助语言. 图1按语言分解了效果,比较了基线,平均去除,以及在回调@20上对一个编码器(mE5-大)和一个解码器(Qune3-8B),对平行的Belebele集合和一个非平行多EuP子集进行分歧引导.

blocks.en: On Belebele, both corrections lift the lowest-scoring languages most, compressing the spread across languages, and the two behave similarly. The non-parallel Multi-EuP subset separates them sharply and reveals where steering matters. For the encoder, mean removal collapses on several languages, dropping recall to 16 16 on Portuguese and 24 24 on Irish, precisely the cases where its per-language mean is least reliable on non-parallel data. Steering does not: it restores recall to 80 80 on Portuguese and 58 58 on Irish, and improves the low-resource Maltese from 50 50 to 81 81 . On the remaining languages, the two are close, with mean removal holding a small edge on a few. Steering thus rescues exactly the languages the alternative abandons.
blocks.zh: 在Belebele上,两种校正都抬高了得分最低的语言,压缩了各语言的分布,两种行为都相似. 非平行的多EuP子集将它们显著地分开,并揭示出方向方向的要害. 对于编码器来说,在几种语言上意味着去除崩溃,葡萄牙语中的16起和爱尔兰语中的24起分别下降到16起和24起,正是这些案例的每个语言的去除平均值在非平行数据上最不可靠。 指导不是:它恢复了葡萄牙语的80个80个和爱尔兰语的58个58个,并使马耳他的低资源从50个提高到81个81个。 在所余语言上,两者相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相相接相接相接相相接相接相相接相接相相相相相接相相相接相相相相接相接相相接相接相相相接相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 因此,引导可以挽救选择所放弃的语言。

blocks.en: The decoder behaves differently. Its baseline recall is already high and uniform across languages, so there is little for either correction to recover, and mean removal is marginally better throughout. The per-language view, therefore, mirrors the aggregate trade-off at its extreme: steering is most valuable where the model and setting are hardest, the encoder on non-parallel data, and least needed where retrieval is already strong.
blocks.zh: 解码器的行为不同. 它的基准召回率已经很高,而且各语文之间都是一致的,因此几乎没有任何纠正可以恢复,而且在整个过程中,平均清除情况略好一些。 因此,每个语言的视角在极端情况下反映了总的取舍:在模型和设置最难的地方,在非平行数据上编码器最有价值,在检索已经很强的地方最不需要。

Steering is therefore not a rescaled mean offset: the behaviorally estimated direction captures structure that a static per-language mean
does not.

blocks.en:
We report cross-lingual agreement under each correction: set agreement A1 (Jaccard overlap of top- K K lists) and rank agreement A2 (Spearman over
shared documents), averaged over languages on Belebele (Table 12 ). Both corrections generally raise agreement over the baseline, most on the self-crowding models, where interference was largest; on bge-m3, whose baseline agreement is already high, steering leaves it roughly unchanged. The de-crowding, therefore, reflects convergence toward the cross-lingual consensus rather than added noise.
